fdroid:app.plugbrain.android.name: PlugBrain: Screen Time Blocker
fdroid:app.plugbrain.android.summary: Block distracting apps with a quick math challenge. Less scrolling, more focus.
fdroid:app.plugbrain.android.description:
Stuck in the scroll? PlugBrain breaks the doomscrolling habit with a quick math problem.
Pick the apps that steal your time and use your phone as usual. When it's time for a break, a math challenge pops up over the app. Solve it to keep going, or tap Leave App and take your time back. Want to think twice before you even start? Turn on a challenge every time a distracting app opens.
The more you scroll, the harder it gets
Every challenge you solve makes the next one tougher. Step away and it eases off again, down to your starting level: Beginner, Intermediate or Expert. More than 40 kinds of problems, from quick sums to multi-digit multiplication, keep your brain switched on.
Why PlugBrain
- An app blocker that makes you think, not a timer you tap past
- Cut screen time on social media, games, videos or any app you choose
- Difficulty that adapts to your own habits
- Works offline, light and dark theme, 13 languages
Private by design
- No ads, no account, no tracking
- No internet permission: nothing leaves your phone
- Free and open source (GPL-3.0)
Permissions
PlugBrain uses usage access, display over other apps and the Accessibility service to see which app is open and show the challenge on top. During a challenge it also blocks calculators. It only reads the name of the open app, never what is on your screen or what you type.

fdroid:com.autopi.name: AutoPie
fdroid:com.autopi.summary: Turn Linux commands into Android apps.
fdroid:com.autopi.description:
AutoPie is a command automation hub for Android. It gives you a Linux environment where you can create, run, and automate Bash commands or Python scripts without using a terminal.
 Use it to build small Android utilities for file conversion, downloads, monitoring, backups, web requests, AI tooling, device workflows, and any other task you would normally solve with Linux packages or scripts.
 Highlights 
 Embedded Termux environment 
 Run Linux commands directly from AutoPie without the Terminal
 Install extra Termux packages with pkg install package-name .
 Install Python packages with pip install package-name .
 Includes useful tooling such as Python, pip, openssh and other utilities out of the box.
 Command and script automation 
 Create custom applets that lives on your homescreen.
 Create applets from Bash commands and Python scripts.
 Add commands to the Android share sheet for quick file, text, and URL workflows.
 Watch folders and automatically process new files.
 Schedule commands with cron-style automation.
 Use interactive command mode when a script needs a live shell session.
 Custom applet creation forms 
 Add text inputs, switches, selectors, file inputs, and other extras to your commands.
 Turn scripts into simple Android workflows that are easy to reuse.
 Use placeholders for files, URLs, text, filenames, directories, random values, and more.
 Ready for practical phone automation 
 Convert videos, audio, images, screenshots, GIFs, and documents with command-line tools.
 Upload, download, rename, compress, and organize files automatically.
 Run web checks, API calls, health monitors, notifications, and custom background jobs.
 Keep the command output and logs accessible from the app.
 Open source Android app 
 Built with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and Material 3.
 Designed for users who want powerful local automation without ads or clutter.
 Permissions 
 All files access: AutoPie runs terminal commands and scripts against files in shared storage. This permission is required so those commands can read, create, modify, monitor, and organize user files and folders.
 Battery optimization exemption: AutoPie requests permission to run without battery optimizations so long-running terminal commands, scheduled jobs, and folder observers can continue working reliably in the background.

fdroid:com.drejo.androidvideoplayer.fdro.name: drejo player
fdroid:com.drejo.androidvideoplayer.fdro.summary: Tiny ad-free player with reliable next/previous across mp4 + mkv folders
fdroid:com.drejo.androidvideoplayer.fdro.description:
A deliberately tiny, free, ad-free, open-source video player whose only job is
to play videos and reliably jump to the next / previous video in the same
folder, including folders that mix .mp4 and .mkv files.
It is built on Android's modern media stack (AndroidX Media3 / ExoPlayer). Every
video in the chosen folder is added to one playlist, so the next / previous
buttons just work across mixed .mp4 + .mkv content; a broken or unsupported file
is skipped instead of freezing playback.
Features:
* Reliable next / previous across a whole folder, regardless of .mp4 vs .mkv.
* Double-tap the right or left side to seek forward / backward; the step grows
 with consecutive taps and is capped relative to the video length.
* Rotation button that can force landscape, force portrait, or follow the
 sensor even when the system rotation lock is on (like YouTube and VLC).
* Optional all-files access (this F-Droid build) so opening any video from any
 file manager lets next / previous work through the whole folder, including
 hidden folders that the media scanner ignores. If you decline the permission,
 the app falls back to the Storage Access Framework folder picker.
No ads, no tracking, no analytics. Plays video only: no audio-player mode, no
image viewer. Released under the MIT license.

fdroid:com.ferlagod.rocinante.name: Rocinante
fdroid:com.ferlagod.rocinante.summary: Fast, private, and native client for the BookWyrm literary social network.
fdroid:com.ferlagod.rocinante.description:
Rocinante is a native Android client for connecting to any BookWyrm instance, the federated social network for readers. Designed with a focus on privacy and performance, it allows you to manage your reading habits without relying on closed platforms or algorithms.
Key features:
- Timeline interaction (ActivityPub): post updates, reply, and like.
- Library management: organize books in default shelves (To Read, Reading, Read).
- Progress tracking: update read pages synchronized with the server.
- Local reminders: configurable daily notifications from the device, without network usage, to encourage reading habits.
- Community exploration: view reviews, currently reading books, and other users' profiles.
- Free and open-source software: transparent code under GPLv3 license, with no trackers or proprietary dependencies.

fdroid:com.fm619.paperphonelite.name: PaperPhoneLite
fdroid:com.fm619.paperphonelite.summary: Encrypted messaging through self-hosted Tor onion services
fdroid:com.fm619.paperphonelite.description:
PaperPhoneLite is a private messaging client for self-hosted PaperPhoneLite onion services.
It bundles Tor and supports private and group chats, attachments, offline data, disappearing messages, signed messages and group keys, offline-password identity verification, safety numbers, optional text-appearance encryption with startup unlocking, and optional ntfy notifications.
A compatible self-hosted server is required. PaperPhoneLite contains no Google Play services, Firebase, advertising, or analytics.
If Tor has no circuit after 20 seconds, the app connects directly outside Tor to bridges.torproject.org to request WebTunnel bridges with the fixed country code cn. It also includes a recovery WebTunnel bridge at ame.neverfeltsogood.top for replacing a known stale cached bridge.
Version 3.1.0 requires compatible upgrades of both clients and the server. Group sends require verified member identities; changed identity keys require verification again. Message signing does not end-to-end encrypt uploaded attachment bytes.

fdroid:com.lightplanx.xddk.name: LightPlan - Reminder & Planner
fdroid:com.lightplanx.xddk.summary: Remind yourself about important tasks. Plan your entire year with a countdown!
fdroid:com.lightplanx.xddk.description:
Light Planner is a FOSS, simple, and intuitive app that will help you with planning events, tasks, or achievements you want to reach!
==============
How does it work?
==============
• Add your tasks in a chosen year quarter
• Write up a title and a description and pick a deadline for it
 That’s it! Upon entering the task area, you will be shown the time you have left to complete it and (optionally) the subtasks you have created in it.
==============
Who is it made for?
==============
 Anyone! No matter the age or height, you can use the app to plan ahead and keep track of the time you have left to complete it at any time.
==============
How is it different from other apps?
==============
 This app was designed to be simple and intuitive, while still looking slick and unintrusive. We also don’t collect any data from users (everything is stored on your device), which means you don’t have to create/link an account and you won’t have to deal with any pesky ads!
Additionally, the project is open-source, so if you feel like changing or adding features, you can do it!
(link to the project repository: https://github.com/XDDK/LightPlan).
I hope you'll find this app useful!

fdroid:com.mobilefork.hermesagent.name: Agent
fdroid:com.mobilefork.hermesagent.summary: Local AI chat, your models, and practical Android tools
fdroid:com.mobilefork.hermesagent.description:
Agent is an independently maintained Android app for local AI chat and practical device workflows.
Choose a model first: open Settings > Models to import a GGUF, LiteRT-LM (.litertlm), or Android .task file with the system file picker. Local import requires neither an account nor an internet connection. Choose an imported or downloaded model and use the start action; the app selects the matching runtime. Model compatibility and available memory still determine whether a model can run.
Optional online providers and downloads are separate from local files. Response preferences, runtime controls, and advanced GGUF settings are grouped under clearly labelled expandable sections. Six interface languages, Android accessibility labels, and confirmation before removing a model help keep controls understandable.
The Full edition includes Android tools for files, app launch, accessibility-assisted actions, notifications, shortcuts, widgets, and automations. Permissions and remote processing remain opt-in. The Play edition has a more restricted tool set.
Agent is not an official Nous Research product and is not endorsed by Nous Research or Teknium. Open-source credits and licenses are retained. The existing application identifier is kept so installed users retain their upgrade path and app data.
Save a diagnostic report without starting a model: Settings > General > Diagnostics and logs > Export diagnostic log. Android lets you choose the folder and filename. Reports include current memory and the last model-start attempt. Review the redacted file before sharing; nothing is uploaded automatically.

fdroid:com.opennotes.name: Open Notes
fdroid:com.opennotes.summary: A minimalist, secure, and fully offline notes app.
fdroid:com.opennotes.description:
OpenNotes is a privacy-focused, offline note-taking application designed to keep your thoughts organized without compromising your data. It provides a fast, clean interface packed with powerful formatting tools.
All your notes are stored exclusively on your local device. The app does not request internet access and contains no trackers or analytics.
Features:
Native Markdown rendering for rich text formatting, including headers, checklists, code blocks, and quotes.
Seamless image support to embed photos directly alongside your text.
Organization tools that allow you to color-code, pin, and sort your notes.
Home screen widgets for quick access to your most important notes.
Built-in privacy options to lock the app behind biometric authentication and block the Android system from taking screenshots of your data.
Personalize the app with dark and light themes, and choose your favorite color for the home screen icon.
Full offline backups that let you export and import your complete note library as a single ZIP file.
Completely free and open-source with zero invasive permissions.

fdroid:de.HS_Aalen.don.name: Aalener Optik-Formelrechner
fdroid:de.HS_Aalen.don.summary: Quick and easy calculate a bunch of optical functions
fdroid:de.HS_Aalen.don.description:
The Aalener Optik-Formelrechner enables a quick and easy option to calculate a bunch of optical functions.
At the moment the following features are implemented:
- Paraxial raytracing
- Exact raytracing for an object on the opitcal axis
- Calculation of oblique crossed cylinders with optional sphere
- Calculation of refraction index.
- Calculation of relative transmission
- Calculation of radii for lenses which are free of spherical aberration or coma
- Calculation and visualization for error of refraction, astigmatism, distortion, volume, weight and dimensions of spherical toric lenses
- Conversion of Back Vertex Distances (eg. glasses to contact lenses)
This application was part of a bachelor thesis for the study program opthalmic optics and audiology at Aalen University. It is meant to check calculations and takes part in the interactive lectures.
Please be advised that the whole application is in german only. If you are an optician it is highly possible that you will understand most of the functions by their formula symbols.

fdroid:org.akanework.gramophone.name: Gramophone
fdroid:org.akanework.gramophone.summary: Simple offline music player with minimalistic design
fdroid:org.akanework.gramophone.description:
Gramophone is an offline, local music player that can play .mp3, .flac, .ogg, .opus, .m4a, .mka and .wav files.
- Light, stable, and minimalistic
- Up-to-date Material 3 design and theme
- Dynamic player UI Monet color
- Uses MediaStore to quickly access on-device music
- Search and browse for your favourite music
- List and grid views
- Browse songs by folder and filesystem
- Natural sorting and various other sorting options
- Playlist support
- Synced lyrics (LRC, TTML, SRT)
- Supports word/syllable Karaoke lyrics synchronization
- Full support for ReplayGain 2.0
- Support for system/third-party Equalizer apps
If you face any issues, feel free to open an issue at our GitHub page: https://github.com/FoedusProgramme/Gramophone/issues 
If you have any security-related or otherwise confidential comments, please email: nift4dev [@] gmail [.] com
Gramophone is open source and released under the GPLv3.0 or later license. We thank all our contributors and translators! https://github.com/FoedusProgramme/Gramophone 
You can help translate Gramophone to your language: https://hosted.weblate.org/engage/gramophone/ 
Note: Gramophone supports the "enhanced album covers" feature. This feature needs the "Photos and videos" permission. This feature is ENTIRELY OPTIONAL and DISABLED BY DEFAULT. We do NOT upload any data anywhere. Your photos are not used, the permission is ONLY used to DISPLAY album covers. That's it.
Note: Not all audio file formats will work on all devices. For more information, please refer to https://developer.android.com/media/media3/exoplayer/supported-formats#progressive-container and https://developer.android.com/media/platform/supported-formats#audio-formats 
Note: Gramophone is completely offline, thus it does not support downloading or streaming music. It will only play music files on your device. Gramophone cannot bypass any copy protections.
Note: Our privacy policy is available at https://foedusprogramme.github.io/org/privacy.html

fdroid:org.nktnet.middor.name: Middor
fdroid:org.nktnet.middor.summary: Mirror applications for HUD display with horizontal flip.
fdroid:org.nktnet.middor.description:
Middor is a free and open-source Android application for mirroring apps on your device.
With built-in support for horizontal flip and 180° rotation, Middor can be used to:
- Display apps on a HUD
- Project content onto a car windscreen (e.g. Google Maps navigation)
- View mirrored images and videos
Middor only supports devices running Android 14 QPR2 or higher, as it relies on the single app screen sharing feature.
For more details, see Android 14 - App Screen Sharing: https://developer.android.com/about/versions/14/features/app-screen-sharing
 Touch controls 
To tap, swipe, or use multitouch on the mirror, turn on Enable Touch Controls
in Settings and enable Middor Touch in Android Accessibility settings.
Gestures follow flips and rotations and replay when you lift your fingers.
Touch controls are optional for view-only mirroring.
For usage instructions, see https://github.com/nktnet1/middor/discussions/2
 Permissions 
- SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW : to draw a mirror overlay on top of other apps
- FOREGROUND_SERVICE : to run the mirror service continuously while the overlay is active
- FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PROJECTION : for capturing the screen content of the underlying app
- BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE : for the optional Middor Touch service
- POST_NOTIFICATIONS : (optional) to display the mirror service notification with additional actions
 Contact 
 Questions/Feature Requests 
Create a Q&A for questions and Ideas for feature requests on GitHub discussions: https://github.com/nktnet1/middor/discussions
 Bugs/Issues 
Report bugs by creating a GitHub issue describing the problem and how it can be reproduced: https://github.com/nktnet1/middor/issues
Please also include your device model, app version and android version.
 Other 
For all other inquiries, please reach out to: support@middor.nktnet.org

fdroid:org.sharkdroid.name: SharkDroid
fdroid:org.sharkdroid.summary: Capture and analyze network packets with Wireshark tools on Android
fdroid:org.sharkdroid.description:
SharkDroid brings Wireshark's dumpcap and tshark tools to Android with a Material 3 interface.
Features:
• Capture packets from Wi-Fi, cellular, VPN, loopback and other available network interfaces.
• Apply BPF capture filters and Wireshark display filters.
• Inspect packet lists, expandable protocol trees and hexadecimal packet bytes.
• Follow TCP/UDP streams and view protocol and conversation statistics.
• Open pcap/pcapng files, save captures, and export or share them.
• Keep captures running in the background with a foreground service.
• Use light or dark themes, dynamic colors, and English or Simplified Chinese.
• Stream captures to desktop Wireshark over an authorized USB adb connection.
Requirements:
Android 10 or later on an arm64-v8a device. Live packet capture requires root access. Opening existing capture files does not require root.
Privacy:
The app has no INTERNET permission, advertisements, analytics or telemetry. Captures stay in app-private storage until you export or share them. tshark uses numeric addresses without reverse DNS lookups.
Limitations:
Wi-Fi monitor mode is not supported. Encrypted TLS/QUIC application content cannot be read without the necessary keys. Some optional desktop Wireshark features are unavailable.
Screenshots show the app interface with demo packet data.
SharkDroid is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by the Wireshark Foundation. Wireshark and the Wireshark fin logo are trademarks of the Wireshark Foundation.

fdroid:spam.blocker.name: SpamBlocker (Call & SMS)
fdroid:spam.blocker.description:
It blocks unwanted calls & SMS messages without replacing your default call/SMS app.

apple-macos:673567077.description:
Az ArtBook digitális művészeti album Andrássy Kurta János művészetét mutatja be életrajza, Feledy Balázs tanulmánya, valamint több, mint 130 alkotás képeinek közlésével.
The Artbook digital fine art album presents the art of sculptor János Andrássy Kurta through his biography, more than 130 images of his works and a study of Balázs Feledy. 
Andrássy Kurta János szobrászművész (1911 – 2008) a népi ihletésű magyar nemzeti szobrászat egyik legjelesebb képviselője volt. Több, mint 60 szobra áll köztereinken. Életművében a plasztikák és domborművek mellett érmek, festmények, rajzok, grafikák is megtalálhatók.
Sculptor János Andrássy Kurta (1911 – 2008) was one of the most outstanding artists of the Hungarian national folk-inspired sculpture. More than 60 of his sculptures stand in public spaces. His oeuvre consists of a significant number of works of art: besides sculptures and reliefs he created paintings, drawings and graphics as well.
Az ArtBook digitális művészeti album egy digitális könyv: fejezetekből áll, és éppen úgy olvasható, mint a hagyományos könyvek. A digitális könyvet a szokásos gesztusokkal lehet használni. A technológia lehetővé teszi a művek megtekintését különböző nézőpontokból, valamint a képek teljes képenyős megjelenítését. A művek katalógusából felhasználóbarát módon lehet válogatni különböző szempontok szerint, ilyenkor csak a kiválasztott művek képei jelennek meg.
The ArtBook fine art album is a digital book: it consists of chapters and it is as readable as the traditional books. You can turn pages back and forth using the well knows gestures. The technology allows to see the objects from multiple perspectives and to open the images in full screen size. The catalogue of the works can be filtered in a userfriendly way by different criteria, visualizing the images of the selected works only.

 Simple interface

 No API keys, no proprietary services/libraries, no telemetry, no spying, no data collection, does not use network permission

 Intel i7-2670QM (2011)

 AMD Ryzen 5 1600 (2017)
 Steam Deck
 GPU is not required or used.

fedora-packages:flexmark-java/flexmark-j.description: Flexmark-java is a Java CommonMark (spec 0.28) parser using the blocks first, inlines after Markdown parsing architecture. Its strengths are speed, flexibility, Markdown source element based AST with details of the source position down to individual characters of lexemes that make up the element and extensibility. The API allows granular control of the parsing process and is optimized for parsing with a large number of installed extensions. The parser and extensions come with plenty of options for parser behavior and HTML rendering variations. The end goal is to have the parser and renderer be able to mimic other parsers with great degree of accuracy. This is now partially complete with the implementation of Markdown Processor Emulation. This package contains an extension for YAML front matter.

fedora-packages:foo2zjs/foo2ddst.name: foo2ddst
fedora-packages:foo2zjs/foo2ddst.summary: Linux printer driver for DDST protocol
fedora-packages:foo2zjs/foo2ddst.description: foo2ddst is an open source printer driver for printers that use the DDST wire protocol for their print data, such as the Ricoh SP 112, or the Ricoh SP 201Nw. These printers are often erroneously referred to as winprinters or GDI printers. However, Microsoft GDI only mandates the API between an application and the printer driver, not the protocol on the wire between the printer driver and the printer. In fact, DDST printers are raster printers which happen to use a very efficient wire protocol. DDST is just one of many wire protocols that are in use today, such as Postscript, PCL, Epson, ZjStream, etc.

fedora-packages:golang-github-oklog-run/.name: golang-github-oklog-run-devel
fedora-packages:golang-github-oklog-run/.summary: Universal mechanism to manage goroutine lifecycles
fedora-packages:golang-github-oklog-run/.description: run.Group is a universal mechanism to manage goroutine lifecycles. Create a zero-value run.Group, and then add actors to it. Actors are defined as a pair of functions: an execute function, which should run synchronously; and an interrupt function, which, when invoked, should cause the execute function to return. Finally, invoke Run, which concurrently runs all of the actors, waits until the first actor exits, invokes the interrupt functions, and finally returns control to the caller only once all actors have returned. This general-purpose API allows callers to model pretty much any runnable task, and achieve well-defined lifecycle semantics for the group. This package contains the source code needed for building packages that reference the following Go import paths: – github.com/oklog/run

This Add-on prevents that websites can open new windows. The "Smart" option tries to determinate, if the new tab is wanted or not. With this option websites can not open more than one tab at a time.
Websites can be added to Blacklist / Whitelist. For every list you can configure separately, what websites are allowed to do. For Example: Block Windows, but allow new tabs.
Popupblocker is not detected as a Popup Blocker by most websites, because it let open the popups and then blocks them.
Features:
- can prevent that websites can open new windows
- can prevent that websites can open new tabs
- "Smart" option: websites can not open more than one tab at a time
- "Block all" option: websites can not open new tabs without your permission
- separated settings for Blacklist / Whitelist
- is not detected as a Popup Blocker by most websites

firefox-addons:2838236.summary: Hides next up card and other obtrusive elements of Amazon Prime Video.
firefox-addons:2838236.description:
The following features are implemented:
◆Hide next up card
◆Skip ads
◆Hide reactions (like/not for me)
◆Hide featured items
◆Hide skip intro button
◆Hide rating
◆Prevents darkening when overlay display is enabled
 - You can also add black outlines for texts and icons
◆Hide X-Ray
◆Hide various text and buttons
 - (While holding down the show key and operating the mouse, it will become temporarily visible)
 - title
 - episode title
 - close button
 - various buttons in the top right
 - seek bar
 - playback time
 - control buttons in the bottom center
 - next episode button
◆Monitor and modify network activity
 - Force playback at highest resolution
 - Remove ad related data
 - Change autoplay flag to true
 - Disable featured items
 - Disable reactions (like/not for me)
 - Try to play the next episode if the video closes automatically

(It is also possible to open the options dialog from the context menu.)
The options dialog allows you to enable/disable the above features.
The options dialog can also be opened by pressing Alt + P / Option + P . (Shortcut keys can be changed)
If you change the options, please reload the page.
This extension runs on primevideo.com and on Amazon in all countries.
However, it has only been tested on amazon.co.jp .

firefox-addons:2729178.name: Return YouTube Dislike
firefox-addons:2729178.summary: Returns ability to see dislike statistics on youtube
firefox-addons:2729178.description:
Return YouTube Dislike restores the ability to see dislikes on YouTube.
ABOUT THE NEW DATA COLLECTION PROMPT
Firefox has introduced a way for extensions to declare the data they send, using a fixed list of categories. Since version 4.0.6 declared RYD's data, Firefox asks existing users to approve four of them before updating: "Personally identifying information", "Browsing activity", "Website content" and "Website activity".
RYD hasn't changed how it handles your data. What changed is how Mozilla labels it. The category names are broad, so an extension that only works on YouTube can look like it watches everything you do. Ajay, the author of SponsorBlock and DeArrow, describes the same problem: https://discourse.mozilla.org/t/the-new-data-transmission-permissions-seem-to-be-misleading-to-users/149410 
WHAT EACH LABEL MEANS FOR RYD
- Personally identifying information: a randomly generated user ID, used to count votes. It isn't derived from or linked to your Google or YouTube account.
- Browsing activity: when you open a YouTube video, the extension sends its video ID to fetch the dislike count.
- Website content: things like the visible like count, which helps estimate dislikes.
- Website activity: your Like or Dislike click, which counts as your vote. You can turn vote submission off in the extension's settings.
- Authentication information (optional): used only if you choose to sign in with Patreon or GitHub.
RYD's site permissions cover only YouTube and its own API at returnyoutubedislikeapi.com . It doesn't read other websites, and these site permissions can't be used to access them.
If you decline the prompt, Firefox keeps your current version. Full details are in the privacy policy linked on this page.
Starting December 13th 2021, YouTube removed the ability to see dislikes from their API. This extension aims to restore power to users by using a combination of archived like and dislike data, as well as the likes and dislikes made by extension users to show the most accurate ratings. The more users that use the extension, the more accurate it will be. Unpopular videos uploaded after December 13th, 2021 may have less accurate data shown than more popular videos.
RYD is a Firefox Recommended extension and is open source, so you can see exactly how it works.
Help: https://returnyoutubedislike.com/help 
Source code and issues: https://github.com/Anarios/return-youtube-dislike

bluejetty:00027293:ios.name: i41CX+
bluejetty:00027293:ios.summary: i41CX+ is an advanced programmable and expandable RPN scientific calculator with a virtual thermal printer/plotter and workstation-class CAS capabilities that is far beyond a mere replica of the original. In addition to being functionally
bluejetty:00027293:ios.description:
i41CX+ is an advanced programmable and expandable RPN scientific calculator with a virtual thermal printer/plotter and workstation-class CAS capabilities that is far beyond a mere replica of the original. In addition to being functionally equivalent to the world-renowned HP-41CX and providing access to its entire library of modules and programs, i41CX+ is enhanced with iOS and hardware features, keyboard overlays, rich set of import and export capabilities, traditional and upbeat diverse set of skins, complete color control, iCloud support, and much more.
The i41CX+ CAS is a full implementation of REDUCE. It's like having Mathematica or the computational engine of Wolfram Alpha in your pocket and, best of all, it runs natively so no internet connection is required. The CAS is fully programmable and provides the ability to reuse previous results in computations. Moreover, the CAS has full access to the calculator registers so it is possible to combine RPN programs with CAS programs.
This is the finest and most powerful scientific/engineering/financial calculator for iOS devices bar none.
CALCULATOR FEATURES:
• RPN logic with a 4 element deep memory stack
• 319 main and 600 extended memory registers
• Over 400 built-in functions, including over 100 functions created specifically for i41CX+
• Time, calendar, alarm, and stopwatch functions
• Four module ports provide access to HP-41 expansion pacs
• Rich set of functions and algorithms: numerical, mathematical, statistical, complex, matrix, numerical integration, curve fitting, solutions to equations, and much more
• Powerful, flexible, and programmable Computer Algebra System (CAS) supporting symbolic, arbitrary precision, scalar, vector and matrix algebra calculations, 2D/3D plotting, and much more
• Full-screen text editor with configurable font style and size, color scheme, a user configurable macro keyboard, and a numerical keyboard
• Access to the entire HP-41 library of solutions for science, mathematics, statistics, engineering, business, financial, surveying, medicine, real estate, and many other domains
• Programmable - virtually unlimited number of lines
• User definable keyboard
• Ability to operate the calculator using a Bluetooth keyboard
• Device integration: external display mirroring, copy and paste, in-app mail, system keyboard, GPS, accelerometer, digital compass, time and date synchronization, AirPrint, and much more
• Virtually unlimited data and program storage capacity using the device's flash memory for local storage
• Import/export data, programs, overlays, modules, etc. via the web, email, and iTunes file sharing
• iCloud syncing of files and preference settings
• iOS 8 Notification Center widget
• 43 available keyboard overlays and support for user created overlays
• Sound support including synthetic tones and interface sounds
• Support for calculator skins and optional mini stack display
• Adjustable calculator speed, sound volume, and display colors
• Usage & Examples table with usage tips and examples
• Quick Reference Guide of all built-in functions
• CAS Quick Reference with all built-in functions, operators, switches, and packages
• Beautiful and clean user interface
PRINTER FEATURES:
• Support for printing, plotting, graphics, and special characters
• User configurable and programmable print color
• Export printer output via email, clipboard, or AirPrint
• Ability to save a JPEG image of the paper roll to the device's photo album
***********************************************************
A comprehensive FAQ and Mini-Manual are available at http://alsoftiphone.com/i41CXplus. Please don't hesitate to use the "Contact Us" link there if you cannot find the answers or information that you seek. Thank you.

bluejetty:00016789:ios.description:
Join Buster Bumblechops in this goopendous adventure to complete the ultimate Moshling collection.
Catch and hatch up to six new Moshlings every day. You can even hatch Ultra Rare Super Moshlings using special Golden Spoons! Along the way you will adopt, name and customize your very own unique pet Moshling, play fun mini-games and solve puzzles as you explore the ever-expanding world of Moshi.
• Find, hatch and collect Moshlings
- Adopt, customise and name your very own unique pet Moshling
- Hatch up to six new Moshlings every day
- Care for your Moshlings, feed them and decorate their home to make them happy
- Find Super Moshlings, ultra rare superheroes in tough-to-crack eggs
• Play together
- Add your friends’ unique Moshlings to your collection
- Send your friends gifts
- Visit your friends’ homes to see who has the best items and rooms
- Browse your friends’ moshling collection
• Solve puzzles, play fun mini-games, collect items

- Learn as you earn Rox: memory, maths, spelling, shapes, mazes, geography, telling the time
- Take a spin on the Wheel of Moshiness for daily rewards
- Custom Moshling house with expandable floors, updated decorations and room items
- Moshi Shopping Mall with Snozzle Wobbleson’s Grossery Store & Dewy’s DIY Shop
Moshi Monsters Egg Hunt is free to play with your parent’s permission.

We do NOT automatically collect personal information through this App. To save game data, users are be required to create an account and submit an email and password.
• Customer Service
We create worlds that fire the imagination. If you have any questions or recommendations please get in touch at egghunt@moshimonsters.com.

bluejetty:00027574:ios.summary:

■ A thou
bluejetty:00027574:ios.description:
Jot it down.
Enjoy checking it off.
Groceries on the way home. A deadline you don't want to miss. A habit you'd like to keep. Do! Spring Pink gives your everyday to-dos a touch of pink: add a task, then double-tap when it's done.
■ A thought, a note, a satisfying checkoff
Catch a task while it's on your mind. Finished? Double-tap to mark it done. Even a small task deserves that little moment of satisfaction.
■ Make it a list you like coming back to
Choose your themes and fonts, with sounds inspired by pen and paper. Like picking a favorite notebook, make your daily list feel like yours.
■ A place for every part of your day
Keep work, study and shopping in their own groups. Add color to tell things apart, and pin the tasks you want to keep in sight.
■ Less to remember, every time around
Set tasks to repeat daily, weekly, monthly or yearly. Add reminders for the things you don't want to miss.
■ A quick look from your home screen
Keep your to-dos close with home screen widgets. Check your list during a busy morning without opening the app.
■ Put your keyboard to work
Use an external keyboard to add tasks and give longer notes room to breathe.
• Add a task: Command(⌘) + N
• Insert a line break: Option(⌥/Alt) + Enter
■ Your list, on your other devices
Use the same app and sign in with the same account to sync your tasks across devices. Pick up your familiar list when you switch devices.
■ App lock and backups
Lock access to the app with a passcode or Face ID on supported devices. Back up your data through Dropbox or email and restore it when needed.
It doesn't have to be a big plan.
Start with one thing you'd like to do today.
■ About ads
This app includes ads. An in-app purchase is available to remove them.
Questions and suggestions: do@simplerion.com

bluejetty:00026843:ios.description:
A game booster that actually works! Say goodbye to game latency, and reach your real gaming potential! 
GearUP is the ultimate gaming companion, accelerating and safeguarding your network. With our patented technology and specialized servers worldwide, we provide gamers around the world with lightning-fast, stable gaming connections. 
► Maximum Performance 
A game booster that actually reduces game lag! We utilize real, patented server technology to set up a better network environment for your device. 
► Minimal Requirements
Our technology ensures that our game booster does not cause higher data usage, higher battery usage or overheating. Perfect for gaming on the go!
► Boost any Game
You can boost popular MOBA games such as Brawl Stars and Mobile Legends, the most-played shooter games like Free Fire, PUBGM and CODM and many other games! We also support all Roblox minigames!
► Patented Technology 
We provide an exclusive path for you to connect directly to the game server! No need to compete with other gamers for the usual congested route, ensuring lower latency and hence lower ping.
► FPS Stability Optimization
Delivers smoother and more stable visuals. With smart boosting technology, it helps stabilize FPS to keep your gameplay consistently smooth in every battle.
► Guaranteed Results
With years of experience building network tools under our belt, we deliver results . We work closely with network service providers in each country to ensure we provide only the best routes to users around the world.
► Easy to use 
Never used a game accelerator before? Worry not! Select the game you wish to play, and click boost. As easy as just one click!
► Free Trial & Subscription
Try before you buy with a free trial and flexible subscription options.
If you’re enjoying a free trial, you will be charged on the last day of your free trial.
Your subscription will renew automatically at the end of each billing cycle, unless canceled at least 24 hours before the expiration date.
Easily manage your subscription and cancel anytime through your App Store account settings.
Purchasing a subscription will result in the forfeiture of any unused portion of a free trial period, if applicable.
You are welcome to read Subscription Terms here: https://mobile.booster.gearupportal.com/happ/statement/subscription

bluejetty:00021183:ios.description:
Had enough of bulky maps and heavy guidebooks? The new free Experience Abu Dhabi mobile app is the easiest and most friendly way to discover the Emirate of Abu Dhabi.
Be the first to know about all that the capital has to offer – from attractions and experiences to culture and heritage, from hotel bookings and restaurants to shopping malls, spas, and nail salons. Booking your stay in Abu Dhabi has never been easier. Find fast and easy-to-navigate information on getting to and around the emirate. Want to watch a movie? Find out where you can book a show, or discover fascinating events happening in the emirate through the Abu Dhabi events calendar. Cool off with our water-sports & cruising experiences, be inspired by our architectural wonders, tee-off at one of our great golf courses or have a once-in-a lifetime desert escape.
Everything you need to know about the emirate – searchable, portable and sent straight to your phone.
Why is the Experience Abu Dhabi mobile app the best way to plan your trip to Abu Dhabi?
• Support for 7 languages: English, Arabic, Chinese, German, Italian, French, Russian
• Extensive, up-to-date information on all there is to see & do in Abu Dhabi
• Make the most of your visit to Abu Dhabi and plan the trip of a lifetime with customized itineraries
• Explore events happening in Abu Dhabi through the Abu Dhabi events section.
• Available with a ‘Near Me’ functionality showing you everything within easy reach
• 'Take me there' icon to help you with navigating to locations no matter where you are on your trip
• Comprehensive, easy-to-navigate map
• Full listings of hotels, restaurants, spas and nail salons with filters to find what’s best for you
• Make your hotel booking straight from the app
• Mark your Favorites and see them in a single page
• Integrated TripAdvisor reviews for all locations, hotels and restaurants
• Inspiring video and photo galleries
• Option to share your trip experience from the app
• Push notifications: Get instant access to all that’s new in Abu Dhabi and make sure you don't miss any destination updates
We want you to have the best experience possible and we take your feedback very seriously. Something not working to your liking? Want to see a new feature? Let us know your comments on
feedback-mobile@visitabudhabi.ae
Please also take the time to rate our application and post a review in the App store.
Enjoy your trip and we hope you have a great time in Abu Dhabi!

Cool off with our water-sports & cruising experiences, be inspired by our architectural wonders, tee-off at one of our great golf courses or have a once-in-a lifetime desert escape.

Everything you need to know about the emirate – searchable, portable and sent straight to your phone.

• Option to share your trip experience from the app

Please also take the time to rate our application and post a review in the App store.

Enjoy your trip and we hope you have a great time in Abu Dhabi!

bluejetty:00022809:ios.description:
HKBUS - Hong Kong Bus
Check real-time arrival information for major bus operators across Hong Kong, including KMB, Long Win, Citybus, New Lantao Bus, Green Minibus, and MTR Bus.
HKBUS provides a clean, straightforward way to find routes, bus stops, and live arrival times for daily commutes and journeys around Hong Kong.
Key Features
• Major Operator Coverage: KMB, Long Win, Citybus, New Lantao Bus, Green Minibus, and MTR Bus
• Route Overview: Browse route numbers, directions, operators, service times, and complete stop sequences
• Trip Planning: Find direct and one-transfer bus journeys with fares, walking distances, and transfer details
• Filter and Sort: Compare journeys by fare or walking distance and filter for same-stop transfers
• Nearby Stops: Find bus stops and routes near your current location
• Route Maps: View complete routes and stop locations on a map
• Favorites and Groups: Save frequently used stops and journey combinations in custom groups
• Browsing History: Quickly revisit previously viewed routes
• Live Arrivals: Refresh arrival information and view upcoming buses
• Widgets: Check saved arrival times from your Home Screen
• Custom Themes: Personalize the app with a selection of themes
• Flexible Keyboard: Use the HKBUS quick keyboard or the system keyboard
• Bilingual Interface: Traditional Chinese and English
Contact Us
For questions, feedback, or suggestions, email:
hkbus.contacts@gmail.com
Data Sources
Arrival and route information is provided by Hong Kong government open-data services and relevant transport operators. Actual services and arrival times may change due to traffic and operating conditions.

bluejetty:00027769:ios.description:
Smart health management for you every day. With beurer HealthManager Pro you always have an overview of your health data - simple, secure and clear. Track your values, identify trends and take your health management to the next level – all from the comfort of your app.
Supports over 40 Bluetooth-/WIFI-enabled devices and more than 85 Scan & Save devices 
More than 4 stars with 25,000+ reviews
1 million+ satisfied users 
More than 25 languages
ALL-IN-ONE SOLUTION
COMPATIBLE WITH MORE THAN 125 BEURER PRODUCTS
Connect your app with products for tracking blood pressure, blood glucose, ECG, weight, pulse oximetry and temperature.
ALL MEASURED DATA IN ONE PLACE
Keep track of all your health data - whether on the go or at home.
Sort your measured values based on reference values, track your trends in clear, easy-to-understand graphs and set your own goals. Add short comments if needed to better clarify specific details.
SCAN & SAVE: TRANSFER DATA QUICKLY AND EASILY
Simply scan your measured values for blood pressure, blood glucose and temperature with the smartphone camera and the results are saved in the app - without Bluetooth®.
MANAGE AND KEEP TRACK OF MEDICATIONS VIA APP
Save your medications in the “medication cabinet” and simply add it to your measurements - so you never forget whether and when you took your tablets and can interpret your measured values correctly.
PERFECTLY PREPARED: SHARE MEASURED VALUES WITH YOUR DOCTOR
Collect your values and send them by email to your doctor or healthcare professional, for example. Export your data clearly and selectively as a PDF or CSV file, if you want to evaluate the data yourself.
YOUR HEALTH DATA DIRECTLY IN APPLE HEALTH
Use the beurer HealthManager Pro in combination with the health app of your choice and transfer data such as weight, blood pressure, activity, sleep, pulse, temperature and pulse oximeter values.
OPTIMAL SUPPORT FOR A HEALTHIER LIFESTYLE (ADDITIONAL SERVICE SUBJECT TO A CHARGE)
Start a healthier everyday routine with “beurer MyHeart”. Access 30 days of our suggestions, healthy recipes, exciting information and daily inspiration, and integrate more wellbeing into your life little by little.
EASILY ANALYSE ECG MEASUREMENTS AT HOME (ADDITIONAL SERVICE SUBJECT TO A CHARGE)
Use “beurer MyCardio Pro” to enable immediate professional evaluation of your ECG measurements at home. Get an instant detailed analysis and report that you can easily share with your doctor.
TRANSFER APP DATA
Conveniently move your data from “beurer HealthManager” to “beurer HealthManager Pro”. Take everything with you, keep your complete history and benefit from a fast, clear and even smarter app.
MEDICAL DISCLAIMER
The app establishes connections with external medical devices (e.g., blood pressure monitors). The app does not use the smartphone’s sensors for measurements.
Compatible medical hardware may require regulatory clearance for use:
Regulatory clearance is available for medical devices for EU/EEA, CH, UK, US, CA, AR, BO, CR, CO, MX, PE, DZ, IN, IL, SA, AE, AU, ID, MY, SG, KR, TW, TH.
In the following regions, no connected medical device is available and only the non-medical hardware in the app is permitted: TN, EG, AL, AM, AZ, BH, BY, BA, BW, CL, CN, SV, FJ, GE, HN, HK, IS, IQ, JO, KZ, QA, KG, KW, LB, MO, MU, MN, NA, NZ, NG, NO, OM, PK, PA, RU, RS, ZW, ZA, TT, TR, UA, UY, BR, PH, LK.
Please verify the local regulatory requirements for clearance before use.
The app is intended to support health monitoring and does not replace professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Users should consult a qualified healthcare professional before making medical decisions.

bluejetty:00026780:ios.name: iFIT Workouts
bluejetty:00026780:ios.summary:
Experience immersive cardio & strength workouts you can do anywhere. Whether you’re on a treadmill, bike, elliptical, rower, or just an exercise mat—iFIT has amazing workouts to help you unlock your personal best.
iFIT’s global fitness pla
bluejetty:00026780:ios.description:
Experience immersive cardio & strength workouts you can do anywhere. Whether you’re on a treadmill, bike, elliptical, rower, or just an exercise mat—iFIT has amazing workouts to help you unlock your personal best.
iFIT’s global fitness platform features over 10,000 on-demand workouts, filmed in stunning outdoor locations across all 7 continents. Explore high-intensity cardio, full-body strength, cycling, yoga, Pilates, HIIT, barre, marathon training plans, stretching, walking, and mindfulness, all led by expert trainers.
Millions of people around the world use iFIT to reach their health goals. Whether you’re looking to build strength, improve endurance, boost mobility, or simply move more, iFIT gives you the tools and motivation to chase every fitness goal.
iFIT workouts can be streamed on compatible devices and paired to your machine via Bluetooth®. If you own iFIT-enabled equipment from NordicTrack, ProForm, or Freemotion, your workouts are even more immersive. SmartAdjust™ tech automatically adapts your machine's speed, incline, or resistance to suit your fitness level. iFIT will base future workouts on your recent performance, making incremental changes to keep you progressing.
No equipment? No problem. Many workouts require nothing more than your own bodyweight. Get daily workouts that are personalized based on your fitness level, goals, and progress, so you always know what to do next.
KEY FEATURES
10,000 Workouts (and counting!): Tap into the one of the world’s largest outdoor workout libraries, with progressive series led by expert trainers who guide you to results.
Top Trainers: Unlock your best performance with iFIT’s 180 elite trainers, pro athletes, and world champions who lead you through every workout. Explore workouts led by the cast of Trainer Games!
Stunning Locations: Exercise all around the world, from Everest basecamp to the salt flats of Bolivia, from the redwoods of California to the peaks of the Pyrenees. 
Options for Every Modality: Whether you use free weights, a NordicTrack or ProForm treadmill, bike, elliptical, rower or no equipment at all, iFIT has workouts for every type of training.
Personalized Fitness: Get AI-powered workout recommendations tailored to your fitness goals and schedule, along with accountability and motivation.
Progressive Plans & Programs: Take the guesswork out of your goals with multi-week trainer-led programs, such as running a 5K, working toward a full marathon, or improving overall strength.
Real-Time Responsive: Feel your machine’s incline, resistance, and speed match your on-screen trainer and the terrain of your workout, dropping you deeper into the experience.
Progress Tracking: Visualize your personal workout stats, track your data, and unlock insights in the app or on your iFIT-enabled machine.
Train Anywhere: No equipment needed for iFIT’s bodyweight, yoga, meditation, and cross-training workouts.
Up to 5 Users with iFIT Pro: Share your plan with your family, each with their own personalized experience and workout tracking.
Subscription Options¹
Choose the iFIT plan that fits your fitness needs:
iFIT Train: $14.99/month or $143.99/year with access for 1 user
iFIT Pro: $39.99/month or $394.99/year with access for up to 5 users
Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled before the end of the billing period. Manage your subscription in your account settings.
Paid iFIT Pro membership required with equipment purchase and to access content and features. Membership auto-renews unless cancelled in advance. Free iFIT account, agreement to terms, and wi-fi required to operate equipment.
AI Coach provided via in-app messaging (see here for regional availability). Existing users who enrolled prior to September 2025 and users who opt-in after that date may continue using AI Coach via a text-based service (US only); msg & data rates may apply.
Terms of Use: https://www.ifit.com/legal/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.ifit.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00014765:ios.name: StarNow Audition Finder
bluejetty:00014765:ios.summary:
Whether you’re just getting started or you’re a seasoned veteran, the StarNow app is the perfect resource for finding and applying to casting calls from all over the world - anytime, from anywhere!
Browse thousands of curated casting calls
bluejetty:00014765:ios.description:
Whether you’re just getting started or you’re a seasoned veteran, the StarNow app is the perfect resource for finding and applying to casting calls from all over the world - anytime, from anywhere!
Browse thousands of curated casting calls from TV shows, movies, independent productions, music videos, voiceover gigs, modeling jobs, and more right at your fingertips. With unlimited applications and media uploads, the StarNow app makes finding your next audition easier and better than ever. Create saved searches tailored to your specifications to be the first to know about (and apply to!) the kinds of jobs you want most.
The StarNow app is free to download, allowing all users to search and browse available casting calls. Upgrade to a subscription to unlock unlimited applications and build a professional talent profile that will wow casting directors. Happy auditioning!
If you choose to purchase a subscription to StarNow, your payment will be charged to your Apple account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew each month or year 24-hours before the end of the current period unless auto-renew is turned off. Auto-renew may be turned off at any time from your Apple account settings. Prices for subscriptions are in U.S. dollars, and may vary in countries other than the U.S. and are subject to change without notice. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period. If you don’t choose to purchase a StarNow subscription, you can continue to use the StarNow app for free. This app includes subscription options, including via optional in-app purchases. If you don’t choose to purchase a StarNow subscription, you can continue to use the StarNow app for free to manage your profile and view job listings, messages, and other resources; however, a subscription is required to utilize some aspects of the service.
Terms of Service:
https://www.starnow.com/terms-of-service/
Privacy policy:
https://www.starnow.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00015094:ios.description:
Chic baby offers fun dress-up and Baby care games for young children 3-6 years old. With cute baby figures, baby outfits, hairstyles, and accessories, it is designed for kindergarten and preschool children, providing an educational experience for kids to play and learn. The game is suitable for young boys and girls 3,4,5 and 6 years old to be able to play on their own, without the support of adults.
Chic baby is brought to you by Pazu Games Ltd, the publisher of popular kids games like Girls Hair Salon, Makeup Girls, Animal Doctor, and others, which are trusted by millions of parents worldwide.
The game provides an opportunity for your kids to express their creativity, spark their imagination, improve their motor skills and enjoy the many accessories and props available.
Pazu games for toddlers are designed especially for boys and girls under the age of 5. It offers fun learning games for toddlers to enjoy, with educational benefits that parents like.
We invite you to try out Pazu games for kids and toddlers for free and discover a wonderful brand for kids games, with a large arsenal of educational and learning games for both boys and girls. Our games offer a variety of game mechanics adapted to the kids’ age and capabilities.
Pazu games have no ads so the kids have no distractions while playing, no accidental ad clicks, and no external interferences.

bluejetty:00027174:ios.summary:
Turn your iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch into a remote control for your Mac or Windows PC.
Browse the web from your couch, control your music, or give a presentation from across the room. Mobile Mouse combines a wireless mouse, multi-touch t
bluejetty:00027174:ios.description:
Turn your iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch into a remote control for your Mac or Windows PC.
Browse the web from your couch, control your music, or give a presentation from across the room. Mobile Mouse combines a wireless mouse, multi-touch trackpad, keyboard, and dedicated media and presentation controls in one app—with no subscription fees.
Use your iPhone or iPad as a trackpad, or control the pointer with the motion of your hand using air mouse mode. On Apple Watch, move the pointer, switch applications, control playback, and navigate presentations right from your wrist.
MOUSE & KEYBOARD
• Multi-touch trackpad with full-screen portrait and landscape modes
• Air mouse control using the motion of your hand
• Remote keyboard with numeric keypad and international keyboard support
• Programmable hotkeys
• A familiar Dock-style application launcher
• Sleep and wake controls for your computer
MUSIC, VIDEO & WEB
• Dedicated media and web remotes
• Playback and volume controls
• Album artwork and track information for Apple Music and Spotify
• Control supported desktop apps and media websites
• Automatically pause or mute media when a call comes in
ACTIONS & CAMERA SCANNING
• Use Actions from apps that support sharing to send photos and text directly to your computer
• Scan text, photos, QR codes, UPC barcodes, and documents with your iPhone camera and insert them into applications on your computer
PRESENTATIONS
• Control Keynote and PowerPoint presentations
• Navigate slides from your iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch
• Access advanced presentation controls with the Pro option
FILE ACCESS & CONTENT SHARING
• Browse files on your computer remotely
• Send photos and text from your computer to your iPhone or iPad
• Send phone numbers to your iPhone or open addresses in Maps
APPLE WATCH
• Trackpad with pointer control and scrolling
• Application switcher for running apps
• Basic presentation controls for moving forward and backward through slides
• Media playback and volume controls
• Album artwork and track information for Apple Music and Spotify
CONNECTIVITY & SECURITY
• Connect over Wi-Fi
• Use Bluetooth or USB on Mac
• Encryption support
• Password protection
OPTIONAL CLOUD ADD-ON (subscription)
• Connect to your computer through the cloud. Great for public networks
• Scan a QR code to open the web remote in your browser
REQUIREMENTS
• iPhone or iPad running iOS 12.0 or later
• Mac running macOS 10.14 or later, or PC running Windows 10 or later
• Wi-Fi router for Wi-Fi connections
• Mobile Mouse Server installed on your computer
GET STARTED
Download and install Mobile Mouse Server on your Mac or Windows PC at https://mobilemouse.com, then connect the app to your computer.
NEED HELP?
Visit https://mobilemouse.com for setup instructions, demos, and troubleshooting. If you need assistance, contact us through the website.
Privacy Policy: https://mobilemouse.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://mobilemouse.com/terms

美股眾多標的不知道該如何選擇嗎？
選股頁面整理不同類型的股票資料，減少來回查找個股所需的時間。

即時追蹤你買進的標的，藉由股價漲跌幅以及即時損益價格，協助整理與管理美股持股，持續查看所持標的的最新狀況。

發現一間新的公司，還需要花時間自己搜尋整理公司表現嗎？
美股 K 線幫你彙整相關資料！
從公司的基本介紹，到損益表、現金流量表、財務比率表和資產負債表等，美股 K 以圖表搭配各年度、季度數據呈現，協助從不同財務指標觀察一家公司的營運表現。

bluejetty:00026689:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00026689:ios.description:
Browse and shop for lululemon gear from anywhere! Be ready for all your sweaty pursuits with technical athletic clothing and accessories for running, cross-training, and yoga.  
Get the gear:
• Shop instantly. Our app is built from the ground up to feel as snappy as your personal bests.
• You’ll find high-quality photos of products taken from every angle and a zoom-in feature that lets you nerd out hard on every technical detail. 
• Inventory-check your local store and find out right from your phone if your size and color are in stock. 
• Favorites: So many products to love, so little time! Add products to your Favorites list so you can easily come back to them later.
• eGift Cards: Buy electronic gift cards for your family and friends through the app and send them directly to their email. 
• Store Locator: Find store hours and locations right on your phone. 
• Pay with ApplePay
Connect with the community:
• Join our global yoga ambassadors for 20, 45 or 60-minute yoga classes
• Find local events tailored to your favorite sweaty pursuits.
• Get inspired by real and authentic stories posted by our own ambassadors and stores.
• Curious about what goes into our gear? Get an insider look through exclusive behind-the-scenes videos.
Manage your account:
• Use Touch ID or Face ID to make sign-in easy; rest assured, your biometric data is protected and safe. 
• My Account: Update your profile and subscribe to product emails in the improved Account settings.
• Store your preferences and purchase information to make checkout a breeze. And of course, standard shipping is always complimentary. 
Founded in Vancouver British Columbia in 1998, the first lululemon athletica store shared space with a yoga studio. We’ve grown quite a bit since then and our technical athletic apparel for men and women is now available online, in stores, and in showrooms all over the world. 
Have an idea, problem, or feedback? Get in touch at gec@lululemon.com

bluejetty:00023932:ios.description:
Finale is a fully-featured Last.fm client with lots of advanced features, including support for easily scrobbling the music around you!
The app allows you to do many of the most common tasks you'd otherwise do on the website:
• See your recent scrobbles
• View your top tracks, artists, and albums over a certain period
• View your weekly charts
• Check your friends' stats
• Search for and get details about albums, artists, and songs
The app also includes lots of advanced features:
• Beautiful home screen widgets for your stats and top artists, albums, and tracks
• Scrobbling from Apple Music (including automatic background scrobbling)
• Manual scrobbling
• Edit/delete scrobbles
• Batch album scrobbling
• Shazam-like scrobbling: just tap a button, give the app a few seconds to listen through your phone's microphone, and the song you're listening to will be recognized for you to scrobble!
• Continuous Shazam-like scrobbling: continuously detect and automatically scrobble music playing around you with just one tap - great for listening to the radio or a record!
• Scrobbling from friends
• Generate beautiful collages of your top artists, albums, and tracks over various time periods
• Search and scrobble from Spotify's database and your Apple Music library
• I'm Feeling Lucky: generate random tracks, artists, and albums from a user's library in a certain period
• Sign in with Strava to see what songs you listened to during your workouts
Finale is, has been, and always will be 100% free, ad-free, and open source. You can find a link to the source code on the About screen. If you like the app, consider leaving a review.

bluejetty:00021215:ios.name: Knit Pro - Pattern Maker
bluejetty:00021215:ios.summary: Transform yarn into beautiful handmade creations with personalized knitting lessons designed for every skill level. Whether you're picking up needles for the first time or refining advanced techniques, our comprehensive platform guides you
bluejetty:00021215:ios.description:
Transform yarn into beautiful handmade creations with personalized knitting lessons designed for every skill level. Whether you're picking up needles for the first time or refining advanced techniques, our comprehensive platform guides you from simple stitches to intricate patterns.
Perfect Your Knitting Skills Step-by-Step
Learning to knit has never been more accessible. Our expertly crafted video tutorials break down complex techniques into simple, manageable steps that anyone can follow. Watch close-up demonstrations of every stitch, pause and replay as needed, and progress at your own comfortable pace. From casting on your first row to mastering cable knits and colorwork, you'll build confidence with each completed project.
Comprehensive Learning Library
Access hundreds of patterns ranging from beginner-friendly dishcloths to advanced garments. Our structured curriculum includes:
• Foundational techniques for absolute beginners
• Clear video demonstrations with multiple camera angles
• Detailed written instructions with helpful tips
• Project-based lessons that teach while you create
• Stitch dictionary covering 200+ essential techniques
• Pattern reading guides to decode any knitting chart
• Troubleshooting tutorials for common mistakes
• Finishing techniques for professional results
Beginner-Friendly Approach
Never touched knitting needles before? Our beginner pathway starts with the absolute basics. Learn how to hold needles comfortably, choose the right yarn for your project, cast on stitches, perform basic knit and purl stitches, and bind off to complete your first project. Within days, you'll complete your first scarf or dishcloth, building the foundation for more complex creations.
Advanced Techniques for Experienced Knitters
Ready to expand your repertoire? Dive into advanced methods including intricate cable patterns, Fair Isle colorwork, lace knitting with delicate yarn overs, circular knitting for seamless garments, short row shaping techniques, and garment construction from patterns. Each technique is demonstrated by experienced instructors who share professional tips and insider tricks.
Diverse Pattern Collection
Explore our ever-growing library of exclusive patterns:
• Scarves, cowls, and infinity wraps
• Hats and beanies for all seasons
• Mittens and fingerless gloves
• Baby blankets and booties
• Sweaters and cardigans
• Shawls and wraps
• Home decor items
• Seasonal decorations
Personalized Learning Experience
Track your progress as you complete lessons and projects. Bookmark favorite patterns for quick access, mark techniques you want to practice, save projects in progress, and build your personal pattern library. Our intelligent recommendation system suggests new patterns based on your skill level and interests.
Start your knitting journey today and discover why millions of people worldwide find joy in this timeless craft. Whether you dream of knitting cozy blankets for your home, creating a handmade wardrobe, or simply enjoying a peaceful creative outlet, we provide everything you need to succeed.
Download now and knit your first project this week.

Privacy Policy: http://thecookbk.com/privacy.php?appname=learn.knitting.Crochet.step

bluejetty:00013981:ios.description:
The default long press to copy text on a mobile screen or image does not always work. This app helps you extract text/words from a mobile screen by sharing your screenshot with the app or by selecting text from an image.
With its advanced OCR technology, this app allows you to extract text and words from your mobile screen and images. The OCR recognition accuracy is between 99% and 100%, ensuring that you get the exact text you need.
You can also scan and translate screenshot or image text on your device in over 100 languages.
Main Features:
• Copy any text on the mobile screen to your clipboard by sharing screenshot with this app.
• Extract text from any image.
• Extract text easily from any application including social media apps like Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, Youtube and more by just share screenshot.
• Extract text on image and read it aloud with text to speech.
• Extracts phone number, email, URL .
• Recent scans history.
• Supports 92 languages for text recognition and translations in over 100 languages.
• Options to automatically copy extracted text to the clipboard or save it as a .txt file for a faster workflow.
How to use this app to extract Text from screen:
Step 1: Take a screenshot.
Step 2: Open that screenshot and share with this app.
Step 3: Select the text by touch and drag on screeenshot and choose the language for OCR recognition.
Step 4: Please wait while the app performs OCR (Optical Character Recognition) operation to extract the text.
Step 5: Now you may copy to clipboard, share or translate the extracted text.
Never struggle to copy text from your mobile screen and Image again. Get Copy Text app now and enjoy the ease of extracting text and words from your mobile screen and Images!
You can take screenshots by pressing and holding the 'POWER BUTTON' and 'VOLUME UP BUTTON' at the same time for a second.

Step into the sh
bluejetty:00026273:ios.description:
Are you ready to embark on a funny adventure of wit, laughter, and brain-teasing challenges? Welcome to Happy Ending, the ultimate riddle and puzzle game that will put your creativity and problem-solving skills to the test!
Step into the shoes of a master storyteller as you delve into a delightful world of surprises and happy conclusions. Picture yourself as the ingenious judge of fate, equipped with a magical box of characters, objects, and settings waiting to be rearranged like pieces of a jigsaw puzzle. Your mission is to create the most uproarious, heartwarming, and unforgettable scenarios for our charming characters.
As the ultimate brain teaser, Happy Ending dares you to unravel clever riddles that will bend and twist your mind. Each level presents a unique challenge, requiring you to think outside the box and devise ingenious solutions. Can you piece together the perfect sequence of events that lead to a joyous outcome?
The gameplay is both fun and addictive. Your objective is simple: put your creativity to the test and conjure up the most hilarious, surprising, and satisfying endings. With every tap and drag, you become the mastermind behind the happiness of your characters. Witness their delight and excitement as your scenarios come to life before your eyes!
But beware, for every level promises new twists and turns, making each challenge more intricate than the last. Don't be fooled by the simplicity of the graphics; beneath the surface lies a complex web of puzzles, just waiting for the right storyteller to weave their magic.
So, are you up for the challenge? Can you be the champion of happy endings? Join us now and embrace the joy of solving riddles, crafting puzzles, and being the source of endless fun and surprise! Remember, in this world, the only limit is your imagination. Get ready to embark on an adventure filled with laughter, satisfaction, and the warm glow of a Happy Ending!

bluejetty:00009033:android.summary:

You were born with the ability to walk other people's dr
bluejetty:00009033:android.description:
Wander the dreamworld full of deadly puzzles, search Hidden Object scenes and defeat Sandman in this point-and-click adventure game.
TRY IT FREE AND THEN BUY THE GAME IF YOU LIKE IT
You were born with the ability to walk other people's dreams. But the blessing turns into a curse, if Sandman, the lord of nightmares, haunts someone dear to you. Years after saving your friend Laura from his evil grasp, you find yourself thrown into another thrilling adventure. Sandman decided to take vengeance, and now Laura’s husband Tim falls into a nightmare. Help him finally wake up in this fascinating Hidden Object game.
GAME FEATURESS
- Quirky dreamworld with changes during walkthrough
- 40+ gaming locations in HD
- More than 30 3D videos and cut-scenes
- 12 logic puzzles and arcade mini-games
- Fascinating Hidden Object scenes
- Collectibles and achievements for experienced players
Be it a dream or a nightmare, this point-and-click adventure is a true eye-candy. With high-quality background artworks and breathtaking 3D videos, it rises above other finding games. It can’t be actually ascribed to seek-and-find games, as it has almost no Hidden Object scenes in their common form. Instead, Mystery Night Adventure sends you on a logic quest to collect clues and solve puzzles through a beautifully crafted world of the dreaming. Be ready to face many challenges and meet weird creatures that dwell in Sandman’s realm. And the devoted fans of finding games can task themselves with spotting all beholders lurking within.
As for the mini-games included, there are both brainteasers and skill games to complement your playing experience. Find your way through the maze or jump on the moving platforms to cross an abyss. Twist your mind with rolling balls and chess puzzles. Decipher hidden messages within cave paintings, entwine the entanglement of threads and prove a brainiac with yet more logic mini-games to pass. Your efforts will be rewarded with achievements for both finding Hidden Objects and puzzle solving. So, prepare to fight your worst fears to wake up your beloved before he falls into darkness once for all. Play this breathtaking Hidden Object adventure game now!
Questions? Contact our tech support at support@absolutist.com

bluejetty:00027069:ios.name: Lyd - Sonos Control & Widgets
bluejetty:00027069:ios.summary:
Control Sonos from your Home Screen, Lock Screen, or Apple Watch. No app to open, no unlock required — just tap and play.
Lyd gives you instant widgets and Dynamic Island controls on iPhone, plus the gold-standard Watch remote trusted since
bluejetty:00027069:ios.description:
Control Sonos from your Home Screen, Lock Screen, or Apple Watch. No app to open, no unlock required — just tap and play.
Lyd gives you instant widgets and Dynamic Island controls on iPhone, plus the gold-standard Watch remote trusted since 2019.
And on iPad, a fully native, big-screen app — library and Now Playing side by side — the Sonos experience iPad users deserve.
Fully compatible with Sonos S2 and even backwards compatible to Sonos S1.
SCENES — YOUR WHOLE SETUP IN ONE TAP
Save the perfect moment once, recreate it forever. A Scene remembers which speakers play together, how loud each one is, and what music starts — then makes it all happen the instant you tap.
• "Morning Kitchen", "Dinner Party", "Movie Night" — a Scene for every moment
• One tap groups your speakers, sets the volume, and starts your music
• Smart suggestions build Scenes from the way you already listen
• Custom icons and names make every Scene your own
• Works on iPhone and Apple Watch, synced across both
• Launch any Scene with Siri, Shortcuts, and automations
INSTANT WIDGET CONTROL
• Home Screen widgets in multiple sizes
• Lock Screen widgets for one-tap access
• Live Activities in Dynamic Island
• Control playback without unlocking your phone
GOLD-STANDARD APPLE WATCH REMOTE
• Full playback control on your wrist
• Rotate the Digital Crown to change volume
• Add complications to any watch face
• Control everything without touching your iPhone
POWERFUL FEATURES
• Works with Sonos S2 and S1 systems
• Volume adjustments with iPhone volume keys
• Group and ungroup speakers
• Play any playlist or radio station
• Send voice messages to any speaker
• Sleep timers for automatic shutoff
• Shortcuts and automation support
• Guest mode for parties
• Multiple Sonos households
ONE-TIME PURCHASE. NO SUBSCRIPTION.
Pay once, use forever. Includes a 14-day free trial with full access to every feature.
---

bluejetty:00016024:ios.description:
Budge Studios™ presents Barbie™ Magical Fashion, where you can transform into a princess, mermaid, fairy, hero or a combination of all four! Design a beautiful outfit, style your hair, and add glittering accessories and colorful make up! Ready to start your magical journey? Anything is possible when you dream big with Barbie!
FEATURES 
• Design a variety of hairstyles and add streaks of color to her hair 
• Apply beautiful fairy tale make-up to complete your magical look
• Decorate your tiara with glittery gems and create a sparkly necklace
• Customize your princess gown and shoes
• Add a mermaid tail, fairy wings or hero accessories – you can even create unicorns!
• Uncover magical gift boxes along the way for fun surprises
• Save your enchanting looks and share them with family and friends
PRIVACY & ADVERTISING
Budge Studios takes children's privacy seriously and ensures that its apps are compliant with privacy laws. This application has received the “ESRB (Entertainment Software Rating Board) Privacy Certified Kids’ Privacy Seal”. For more information, please visit our privacy policy at: https://budgestudios.com/en/legal/privacy-policy/, or email our Data Protection Officer at: privacy@budgestudios.ca
Before you download this app, please note that it is free to try, but some content may only be available via in-app purchases. In-app purchases cost real money and are charged to your account. To disable or adjust the ability to make in-app purchases, change your device settings. This app may contain contextual advertising (including the option to watch ads for rewards) from Budge Studios regarding other apps we publish, from our partners and from third parties. Budge Studios does not permit behavioral advertising or retargeting in this app. The app may also contain social media links that are only accessible behind a parental gate.
Please note that this app gives users the ability to take and/or create photos in-app that can be saved locally to their devices. These photos are never shared with other users in-app, nor are they shared by Budge Studios with any unaffiliated third party companies.
TERMS OF USE / END-USER LICENSE AGREEMENT

Budge Studios was founded in 2010 with the mission to entertain and educate children around the world, through innovation, creativity and fun. Elevate your Vancouver adventures with the Mobi by Rogers app – the quickest way to sign up and get riding. Our classic bikes and ebikes can be unlocked and returned to any Mobi by Rogers station throughout the city, making bike share ideal for getting around Vancouver.

bluejetty:00029891:android.description:
AOF is a 5v5 MOBA competitive game based on a background of the battle between The Deities and Human Beings. There are legends from various mythologies and authentic history that you can act as, joining with your teamates in the ield of Vegrild during the twilight of the gods. Skillfully utilizing your abilities and tactics, strive for victory in this sacred battle.
Full eSports Experience：AOF is entirely eSports-oriented, featuring comprehensive competitive content. Participants, ranging from individuals to teams and clubs, engage in competitions at various levels —— Arena Battle, Cup Math, and Tournament.
Cross-Platform Linking：AOF offers cross-platform gameplay, allowing PC players to challenge opponents on mobile devices.
Global Unification：Unlike other games where players choose a server before playing, AOF features a global interconnected server system.
Full Blockchain eSports：The AOF's event system is entirely based on blockchain, ensuring the fairness and impartiality of the competitions.
High-Quality MOBA Experience：AOF sets a new standard in graphical quality and game stability within the MOBA genre. Keeping pace with the rapid advancements in mobile technology, AOF's project quality continues to evolve, rivaling traditional MOBA games.
