bluejetty:00013878:ios.description:
Book Keeper Accounting is a business accounting app for small and medium businesses. It supports taxation like GST, VAT etc. It’s simple user interface allows you to send invoices & estimates, track expenses & receipts, manage inventory, view & send various financial reports and much more. It's a complete accounting package which helps you maintain your company books and do all financial accounting.
*********** Fully GST compatible ***********
Book Keeper is GST ready for Indian businesses. Businesses can create GST invoices and see the appropriate taxes captured on each transaction. Generate GST reports (GSTR1, 2, 3B, 4) & file GST returns.
*********** 14 days FREE trial. No signup required!! ***********
Try the app FREE for 14 days, after which you can opt for yearly subscription (starting $60/year or INR 2500/year) or one time purchase plan (starting $200 or INR 8000)
• Unlimited features: Create unlimited accounts, inventory, companies, transactions. No limit!!
• Invoicing: Invoices for products and services; Customise invoice fields like quantity, rate, amount in words, shipping details; Add company logo to invoices; Sign your invoices; Email invoice PDF or take prints; Track paid & outstanding invoices
• Estimates: Create and send estimates to your customers, convert them to invoices later
• Expenses/Receipts: Enter business expenses; payments made; income earned; analyse profits earned
• Inventory Management: Manage your entire inventory in different warehouses
• Financial reports: In depth analysis of your business with 25 comprehensive reports
• No Internet connection required: Offline accounting app, manage accounts on the go
• Stand-alone app: Maintain financial accounting books, no dependency on other software, no sign up required
• No prior accounting know-how: Maintain accounting books with ease, no accounting/bookkeeping knowledge required
• Online Sync: Sync your company data across multiple devices via Dropbox. All data entered on one device gets reflected on other device at the same time!!
• Multiple Users: You can collaborate with your employees and accountants. Multiple users collaborate on the same company with user-level permissions.
It is based on professional accounting principles to ensure balanced books and accurate reports.
Just enter your daily vouchers and let Book Keeper does all the double-entry accounting.
Accounting
• Easy, real accounting
• Accountant approved
• Maintain individual ledgers/accounts
• Automatic computation of profit/loss
Transactions
• Create sales, purchase, receipts, payments, banking transactions (single-entry & double-entry mode)
• Generate invoices and mail them to customers
• Send estimates & convert them to invoices
• Enter tax vouchers, view tax computation
• Keep track of paid/unpaid invoice, outstanding receivable/payable with aging analysis
Order generation
• Generate sales order/estimates, issue purchase order
Inventory Management
• Create individual inventory items with your own units of measure.
• Manage warehouses
• Record purchase/sale/purchase return/sales return voucher entries of these items.
• Record manufacturing journals.
• Automatic valuation of closing inventory based on Average or FIFO method.
Reports
• View various financial accounting reports (Trial Balance, P&L A/C, Trading A/C, Balance Sheet etc.) which are automatically generated
• View detailed reports of each inventory item/service
• View summary of all inventory item
Receipt/Payment
• Get paid faster by providing bank details in invoice footer. 
Our vision is to reduce the manual work and automate the business accounting/bookkeeping as much as possible so that business owners can focus more on growing business and spend less and less time on maintaining daily business transactions.

bluejetty:00022347:ios.description:
Discover your body’s rhythm with a scientifically based fertility tracker designed to help you plan or avoid pregnancy naturally.
Simply enter the first day of your last period, and the app predicts your next period, ovulation day, and the most fertile and least fertile days of your cycle.
With Apple Health sync, your data stays automatically updated across all your Apple devices — so your fertility insights are always with you.
* Scientifically Backed Methods *
Our app includes two baby gender prediction methods:
 • Popular Method – a theoretical approach based on the well-known theory by Landrum Shettles, which suggests that the timing within the fertile window may influence the baby’s gender.
 • Scientific Method – a statistical, research-based approach developed by Rodrigo Guerrero, grounded in large-scale data from thousands of women.
You can switch between them anytime in Settings.
Please note: both methods provide probabilistic insights, not guaranteed results.
* Full Version Features *
Unlock deeper insights with the full version:
 • Daily pregnancy probability for any selected date.
 • Gender prediction probabilities for each fertile day.
 • Overall fertility chances during your current cycle.
 • Automatic Apple Health sync between devices.
* How It Works *
To create your personal fertility calendar, simply provide:
 • The first day of your last period.
 • Your average cycle length.
 • Your luteal phase length (default works for most users).
Ideal for women with regular cycles — but also reliable for estimating ovulation using your average cycle length.
* Empower Your Reproductive Journey *
Whether you’re trying to conceive or prefer natural birth control, this app provides clarity, accuracy, and peace of mind — backed by science and made even smarter with Apple Health integration.
Disclaimer: This app is intended for informational and educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a qualified healthcare provider before making decisions related to contraception, fertility, or pregnancy. Accuracy may vary depending on individual factors.

apple-macos:539883307.description:
LINE reshapes communication around the globe, letting you enjoy not only messaging but also free voice and video calls wherever you find yourself. Download LINE now and stay close with your favorite people.
◆ Free voice and video calls any time, anywhere. Share your screen during video conferences.
Enjoy great quality calls free of charge, no matter where you are. Up to 500 people can join a group call. Host video conferences and online gatherings with the all-new Screen Share feature.
◆ Convenient chats where anything is possible!
Send and receive messages, photos, videos, stickers, and even large files from your friends.
◆ Auto-sync your device and PC
Your LINE chats are always up-to-date! Whether on the go with the mobile version or connected to the desktop version at work or home, your LINE is synced automatically across all versions.
◆ Your own private chat, Keep Memo
Send memos, photos, and more to your personal Keep Memo chat.
◆ Enjoy secure chats with Letter Sealing
All your chat messages, calls, and shared locations can be encrypted using Letter Sealing. Your chats are always safe in LINE!

apple-itunes:1549535491.description:
MX Video Player – Your All-in-One Media Player
MX Video Player is your media companion on iOS. Enjoy your favorite videos, music, and supported network streams with smooth playback, powerful controls, and a simple media library.
## Play Your Videos with Ease
Enjoy your favorite videos with support for a wide range of formats, including MKV, MP4, AVI, MOV, WMV, and more.
- 4K and Full HD video playback
- Subtitle and external audio track support
- Picture-in-Picture (PiP) mode
- Gesture controls for volume, brightness, and seeking
- Playback speed control
- Screen lock mode
- Aspect ratio adjustments
## Powerful Video Player
Enjoy a flexible viewing experience with features designed for everyday playback.
- Support for AVI, MKV, MP4, MOV, WMV, 3GP, FLV, MPG, TS, and M4V
- Embedded and external subtitles
- Multiple audio track support
- Playback speed adjustments
- Smooth seeking and gesture controls
- Flexible display and aspect ratio options
## Built-in Music Player
Listen to your favorite music and audio files with convenient playback controls.
- Supports MP3, AAC, FLAC, WAV, and more
- Background audio playback
- Lock Screen playback controls
- Convenient audio library
## Smart Video Editing Tools
Make quick edits to your videos with built-in tools.
- Trim video clips
- Mute audio
- Loop video segments
- Reverse video
- Extract audio
- Add background music
- Convert video clips to GIF
- Compress videos for sharing
## Online and Network Media Player
Play supported online media streams using compatible network URLs.
- MP4 network stream playback
- M3U and M3U8 playlist and stream support
- Support for compatible HTTP and other network protocols
- Simple network playback interface
Network playback is intended for content that you own or are authorized to access. Playback availability depends on the source, format, and network configuration.
## Media Library and File Management
Keep your media library organized and easy to access.
- Organize videos and music into folders
- Rename and manage supported local files
- Share supported files
- Access compatible media through the Files app and iCloud Drive
- Transfer files using supported Wi-Fi transfer and iTunes file-sharing features
## A Smooth Media Experience
Whether you enjoy movies, personal videos, music, or compatible online streams, MX Video Player brings your media together in one convenient app.
Enjoy a streamlined, ad-free media experience with Premium features available through an optional subscription.
Rate and review the app to share your feedback and help us improve.
## Unlock Premium Features
Choose a subscription to access the Premium features offered in the app.
**Available subscriptions:**
- Weekly Premium — $2.99 per week
- Annual Premium — $14.99 per year
### Subscription Information
- Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- You can manage or cancel your subscriptions in your Apple Account settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
**Terms of Use (EULA):** https://shellinfra.com/tos.html
**Privacy Policy:** https://shellinfra.com/privacy-policy.html
